nodes.label: Repository Pattern (Data Access)
nodes.rationale: Every domain has a *.repository.ts that is the only file touching Supabase; services call repositories, never Supabase directly, keeping database concerns isolated and testable.

nodes.label: Factory Pattern (Shipping)
nodes.rationale: All shipping providers implement IShippingProvider (createDelivery, trackDelivery, cancelDelivery, mapStatus) and are registered in shipping.factory.ts, enabling pluggable Bosta/ABS/Mylerz providers.

nodes.label: State Machine Pattern (Orders)
nodes.rationale: orderStateMachine.ts maps each OrderStatus to valid transitions and available actions; status flow is pending -> approved -> shipped -> delivered, with cancelled/returned branches.

nodes.label: RTK Query + Tag Invalidation (Client State)
nodes.rationale: Each domain has an RTK Query API slice using providesTags/invalidatesTags for automatic cache management; all API slices use baseQueryWithAuth which injects the Bearer token from Redux state.

nodes.label: WhatsApp CRM Messaging via n8n
nodes.rationale: The backend never calls Evolution API directly; all WhatsApp sends go through n8n (whatsapp.service.ts -> n8n webhook -> Evolution API plugin), keeping outbound/inbound/notification flows decoupled from the plugin implementation.

nodes.label: Admin Authentication Flow
nodes.rationale: Admin logs in via Supabase Auth, receives a JWT stored in Redux+localStorage; verifyAdmin() checks JWT validity AND membership in the admins Supabase table for every protected API route.

nodes.label: Dynamic Product Landing Pages
nodes.rationale: Each product's unique slug generates a landing page at /{slug}; the [slug]/page.tsx Server Component fetches by slug, 404s if missing/inactive, and renders the checkout funnel with dynamic SEO metadata.

nodes.label: Service ↔ Repository Separation
nodes.rationale: Repositories run server-only and do raw Supabase queries with no business logic; services run server-only and orchestrate business logic by calling repositories — never import a Repository or Service in a client component.
